mathematical_meanings: Left image: y names the vertical coordinate axis (the top arrow of the axis along the parabola’s symmetry line). Right image: y names the vertical coordinate axis (the upper end of the vertical axis passing through points 1 and 3).
Rationales: In both images, y names the vertical coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the top arrow of the axis along the parabola’s symmetry line on the left and the upper end of the vertical axis passing through points 1 and 3 on the right.
